breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated sign convention by redefining positive shear and bending moment after already specifying upward shear on the left cut face and sagging as positive.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses only one consistent sign convention: positive shear V upward on the left cut face and positive bending moment M causing sagging (tension at the bottom fibers). The contradictory redefinition of the sign convention (downward shear on left cut face and hogging as positive) that appeared in the incomplete prompt has been removed entirely, matching the ground truth.
